Nobody corrects Allyson's idea that raising rates makes borrowing cheaper, and the story ends by telling students to say it is unknown whether the rate hikes caused the fall in inflation. Higher rates make borrowing more expensive, and the Volcker rate hikes are widely credited with ending the inflation (Wikipedia, Volcker_shock).

Pink cobalt chloride paper is shown turning blue when dipped in hot and in cold water. Cobalt chloride paper is pink when wet and blue only when dry or dehydrated, and cold favours pink (Wikipedia, Cobalt(II)_chloride).

Tocqueville's 1856 book is said to come 'thirty years after the Paris archive burned'. The Paris municipal archives burned in May 1871, after the book appeared and after Tocqueville's death (Wikipedia, Archives_nationales_(France)).

Grandpa can grow a basket of apples for the cost of 3 jars of honey, so he gains only if he pays fewer than 3 jars. The story inverts this: it says he is better off growing his own below 3 and calls 3-6 a win-win range. The terms of trade must lie between the two opportunity costs (Wikipedia, Comparative_advantage).
